en:
Your failure to protect Gryphon
doomed the rebellion.
Without the information
only he could provide,
Ultor's troops and the Plague
wiped out Eos and the Red Faction.
zh: 你没能保护格里芬，导致了反抗军的覆灭。\n没有他才能提供的情报，乌尔托的部队和瘟疫消灭了伊欧丝和红色派系。

en:
Eos, the leader of the Red Faction rebellion,
is dead.

Without her leadership,
Ultor prevailed and
wiped out the rest of the Red Faction.
zh: 红色派系反抗军的领袖伊欧丝已经死了。\n\n失去了她的领导后，乌尔托取得了胜利，并消灭了红色派系的残余力量。

en:
By failing to destroy the missile command center,
you doomed your mission to reach
the space station.
With Ultor's planetary defense system intact,
the EDF fleet was destroyed
before it could reach Mars.

The Red Faction rebellion failed.
zh:
你没能摧毁导弹指挥中心，导致前往空间站的任务彻底失败。
乌尔托的行星防御系统仍完好无损，EDF舰队还没抵达火星就被摧毁了。

红色派系反抗失败了。

en:
Well, you missed the shuttle.
Because you didn't reach the space station
in time to disable Ultor's planetary defense system,
the EDF fleet was destroyed
before it could reach Mars.

The Red Faction rebellion failed.
zh:
好吧，你错过了航天飞机。
由于你没能及时抵达空间站关闭乌尔托的行星防御系统，EDF舰队还没抵达火星就被摧毁了。

红色派系反抗失败了。

en:
The death of this lowly technician,
insignificant as it might seem,
has doomed the Red Faction revolt.

Without his help,
you were unable to destroy
the geothermal power plant.
Ultor's monitoring system remained
fully operational and enabled
the company's security forces
to counter every move
the Red Faction forces made.
zh:
这名低级技术员的死亡，看似无关紧要，却注定了红色派系起义的失败。

没有他的帮助，你无法摧毁地热发电厂。
乌尔托的监控系统仍然正常运作，使公司的安保部队得以反制红色派系部队的每一次行动。

en:
The Red Faction has no room for
Ultor sympathizers. 
When the revolution comes,
take care that you're on the right side.
zh: 红色派系容不下乌尔托的同情者。 \n革命到来之时，不要站错了队。

en: Because of your inaction,\nEos died and the rebellion failed.
zh: 由于你的无所作为，\n伊欧丝死了，反抗也失败了。

en:
When the bomb's timer expired,
a thermonuclear explosion of tremendous force
vaporized everyone and every thing
in the mining complex.
Ultor succeeded in ending the
Red Faction rebellion and
in destroying all evidence
of its experiments on Mars.
zh: 炸弹计时器归零时，一场威力巨大的热核爆炸将采矿设施中的所有人和一切全部蒸发。\n乌尔托成功终结了红色派系的反抗，并摧毁了其在火星上进行实验的所有证据。

en:
By allowing the technician to stop the missile 
launch, you enabled Ultor's missile defense 
system to stay operational.
You were unable to reach the space station to
disable Ultor's planetary defenses and
the incoming EDF fleet was destroyed.
The Red Faction rebellion failed.
zh: 你放任技术员阻止导弹发射，使乌尔托的导弹防御系统得以继续运作。\n你没能抵达空间站关闭乌尔托的行星防御系统，来袭的EDF舰队也被摧毁了。\n红色派系反抗失败了。

en: You failed to reach the escape pod in time.\nYour death in the explosion of the space station\nspelled the end for the Red Faction rebellion.
zh: 你没能及时抵达逃生舱。\n你死于空间站爆炸，也宣告了红色派系反抗的终结。

en:
By killing this miner, you lost any chance
of infiltrating Ultor's Administrative offices.
Without the information Deputy Admin Gryphon
could provide, the rebellion failed.
zh: 杀死这名矿工后，你失去了潜入乌尔托行政办公室的一切机会。\n没有副行政主管格里芬提供的情报，反抗失败了。

en:
Hendrix's death was the final nail
in the Red Faction rebellion's coffin.
Without his technical expertise and
inner knowledge of Ultor's systems,
Masako and her mercenaries were able to
escape from Mars and destroy the complex
behind them, erasing all evidence
of Ultor's wrongdoing.
zh: 亨德里克斯的死，成了红色派系反抗棺材上的最后一颗钉子。\n没有他的技术专长，以及对乌尔托系统的内部了解，\n雅子和她的雇佣兵得以逃离火星，并摧毁身后的设施，抹去了乌尔托罪行的所有证据。
